slides.texte_overlay:
5 things that will pull you
out of your dopamine addiction

boredom walks

walk without your phone, headphones or a destination. let your brain crave stimulation until it remembers how to create its own ideas and find calm again.

analog mornings

spend the first hour of the day with no screens at all. write with a pen, stretch, look out of the window, and let your brain reset its reward system.

swapping, not just stopping

replace a few minutes of scrolling with a slower kind of reward, like learning something real about a planet or a myth. slow rewards rebuild your patience.
slides.texte_sophia:
swapping, not just stopping

swap scrolling for a slower reward. the Sophia app turns learning into one short lesson a day, a planet or a myth, and those 5 minutes feel far better than another feed.

slides.texte_overlay:
single tasking

do one thing at a time with zero distractions for twenty five minutes. eat without scrolling, shower without a podcast, and feel your focus slowly come back.

adding friction

delete the apps you can't stop opening, log out and put your phone in another room. make quick dopamine hits inconvenient until your brain stops begging for them.
